description: Franka hand collision geometry in the TCP frame (TCP = panda_hand + 0.1034 m along hand z; x = hand x, y = closing axis, z = approach). AABBs of the Isaac Lab FRANKA_PANDA_HIGH_PD_CFG collision hulls, symmetrised in x/y. Metres.

notes.width: w = pad-to-pad distance = 2 x finger joint position (finger_joint1/2 in [0, 0.04]); verified in Isaac: finger body origin at hand y = +-q_f, pad plane at finger-frame y = 0
notes.tcp_vs_pads: TCP (z = 0, midway between the pad planes) lies on the flat pad face, which spans TCP z [-0.0143, 0.0087] (centre -0.0028); fingertips at TCP z = 0.0088 (TCP is 8.8 mm behind the fingertips), finger root at z = -0.0449; the finger boxes overlap the palm by 7.4 mm in z
